markup: <Button Content="Confirm"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="ConfirmSound">Source = "audio/confirm.wav"; Volume = 0.8; @parameter ToneCutoff: float = 1200; @parameter EchoMix: float = 0.15; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = ToneCutoff; } @modifier Delay { Time = 120ms; Feedback = 0.20; Mix = EchoMix; }</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Playback; @on Click { @sound $ConfirmSound(Volume = 0.2, ToneCutoff = 800) as Playback; }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<Border><Border.Resources><SoundClip Name="Music">Source = "audio/music.ogg"; Loop = true;</SoundClip></Border.Resources><Border.Aspect>@handle Track; @on Loaded { @sound $Music as Track; }</Border.Aspect></Border>

note: One parameter feeds two modifier inputs; its range is the intersection of the inputs it feeds.
markup: <Border><Border.Resources><SoundClip Name="Wash">Source = "audio/wash.wav"; @parameter Amount: float = 0.3; @modifier Delay { Feedback = Amount; Mix = Amount; } @modifier LowPass { }</SoundClip></Border.Resources><Border.Aspect>@on Loaded { @sound $Wash(Amount = 0.9); }</Border.Aspect></Border>

note: The nearest resource scope wins, as for every other typed resource.
markup: <StackPanel><StackPanel.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/outer.wav";</SoundClip></StackPanel.Resources><Border><Border.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/inner.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 900; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; }</SoundClip></Border.Resources><Button Content="Inner"><Button.Aspect>@on Click { @sound $Tone(Cut = 400); }</Button.Aspect></Button></Border></StackPanel>

<Border><Border.Resources><SoundClip Name="ErrorSound">Source = "audio/error.wav";</SoundClip></Border.Resources><Border.Aspect>@handle Playback; @when $self.IsEnabled { @if value == true { @sound $ErrorSound as Playback; } @if value == false { @cancel Playback; } }</Border.Aspect></Border>

<Button Content="Music"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="BackgroundMusic">Source = "audio/music.ogg";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Music; @on Loaded { @sound $BackgroundMusic(Loop = true) as Music; } @on Click { @pause Music; } @on MouseEnter { @resume Music; } @on MouseLeave { @seek Music to 30s; }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: @sound starts in source order before the single visual Motion root; it is not a Motion execution child.
markup: <Button Content="Mixed"><Button.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@on Click { @sound $Tone; @animate with Tween(200ms, EaseOut) { @to { Opacity = 0.5; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<StackPanel><StackPanel.Resources><SoundClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</SoundClip><Aspect Name="Clicky" TargetType="Button">@on Click { @sound $Tone; }</Aspect></StackPanel.Resources><Button Content="A" Aspect="$Clicky" /><Button Content="B" Aspect="$Clicky" /></StackPanel>
